full_description: WalkBuddy is a fitness app that encourages users to walk more by tracking their daily steps and providing rewards for reaching milestones. It also offers guided walking tours and outdoor activities, helping you stay motivated and active. With WalkBuddy, you can set goals, track progress, and compete with friends to make walking a fun and engaging experience. Download WalkBuddy now and start walking your way to a healthier, happier you!
